causal_limitation: Repeating O on the same saved JSON cannot identify information lost in image-to-text conversion. That would require a separate controlled paired intervention on available spatial information/input modality, holding tasks and relevant generation settings fixed; it is not implemented here.
checkpoint_policy: Only a separately approved future plan may create fresh local immutable checkpoints and a new GitHub draft; verify byte digests and restoration, halt on save failure, never modify the existing three drafts.
future_checks_before_approval: verify selected rest input availability without silent replacement
resolve previous-exposure scope and acceptable independent-validation claim
verify current exact model IDs, schema support, context/output limits and official prices on execution date
freeze a separate future protocol before inspecting its outcomes
obtain explicit new cost/call/token scope and fresh real-TTY human authorization

historical_reservation_policies.policy: full documented context input plus output cap; cumulative USD30 includes all old consumption; not completion cost prediction
full documented context input plus output cap; not measured or guaranteed completion cost

historical_protocol.reservation_interpretation: Historic full-context input plus output-cap reservation; not a measured token count, future context-fit proof, empirical completion cost, or invoice.

one_builder_scope_limit: Dropping one Builder reduces calls but cannot independently check the trade-off for both systems; not added as a third candidate.
preference_reason: R1 uses 60 calls and R3 uses 180; single-generation eval60 cannot identify within-building repeat variance or establish the precision gain needed to justify R3. Neither 30 buildings nor either configuration is certified sufficient.
primary_estimand: equal-building mean aligned occupancy IoU: Builder minus same-input deterministic filled-box
provider_selection: Fixed in QUESTION_REGISTER/ANALYSIS_PLAN before new Goal011 arithmetic; historical provenance and shared 1800-cap description design, not favorable downstream effect selection.
unknown_usage_policy: Reserve before any future POST; retain unknown-use holds, halt on uncertain response, no automatic resend or retry.

validity_and_missing_policy.no_eligible_repeat_for_building: Exclude only from the conditional common-valid mean; retain planned N30 and report actual eligible buildings and pairs for each Builder.
validity_and_missing_policy.primary: common-valid identical core-mask; average eligible repeats within each building before equal-building mean
validity_and_missing_policy.reliability_denominator: All fixed planned slots per Builder:30*r; unknown/operational missing and known output failures remain separate.
validity_and_missing_policy.secondary: separate bounded known-definitive-output-failure0 sensitivity and independent failure/unknown rates
validity_and_missing_policy.successful_empty_output: Retain as normal success; undefined metrics remain NULL and never reclassify as model failure.
validity_and_missing_policy.unknown_or_resource_missing: NULL, never0; retain fixed planned buildings, attempt identities and missing reasons
